verdict.rationale: DBOS explicitly documents workflow fork/replay from a specific completed step for debugging (dbos-docs-13), and Conductor's dashboard/API/CLI let engineers restart any workflow from a specific step to recover from incidents (dbos-docs-16, dbos-docs-17, dbos-probe-rt-4). Automatic crash recovery from last checkpoint is also documented and demonstrated (dbos-docs-3, dbos-docs-4). missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the fork-from-step feature working in practice (only vendor docs cited), and community notes that self-hostable observability/UI was still catching up (dbos-comm-8, dbos-comm-11) slightly temper confidence in full parity everywhere.
